body.name: Finite-grid certification construction
body.construction: For an input in \(\mathfrak I_{\mathrm{rep}}\) and \(\varepsilon>0\), enumerate rational state nets from the finite rational-inequality encoding of \(\mathcal H\), project rational full-box design nets through \(P_B\), truncate and tile the Gaussian observation space by rational rectangles, call \(\operatorname{GRect}\) with explicit tolerances \(\zeta_{\mathrm{tail}}\), \(\zeta_{\mathrm{quad}}\), and \(\zeta_{\mathrm{round}}\) for every rectangle probability, solve the finite games with rational primal and dual certificates, and refine the state, design, observation, tail, integration, rounding, and optimization errors until their proved sum is at most \(\varepsilon\).
